snippet.title: The State of Nowhere | Latin American Games Showcase TGA 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
"The State of Nowhere" is a casual single-player simulation game set in a totalitarian state, where you take on the role of a state employee responsible for providing food to the citizens. It will be your responsibility to control and decide who will be able to receive their food.
